question: I'd like to know what kind of change there was in Roswaal's feelings due to Otto lending a hand with the domestic affairs that Roswaal had been handling by himself.
answer: If you're asking if things have gotten easier due to adding in Otto, then that really hasn't happened. It's just that Roswaal can handle the part of the business that he wasn't able to take care of until now, so Roswaal's workload itself hasn't changed. He is being helpful, and finishes the work while complaining, so the amount that gets pushed onto him continues to increase.
